# 0 schedule-years left out because places disagree, and the years of 10 rules
# whose Hijri or Hebrew date differs from the calendar of the language (Umm al-Qura; Hebrew).
# Rules not translated, by reason:
#   57 a date form the translator doesn't know
#   38 a time of day or a duration in hours
#   15 Orthodox (Julian) Easter
#   10 the Persian calendar
#   8 the Bengali calendar
#   4 depends on other holidays
#   4 a Chinese solar term
#   2 equinox or solstice
#   2 observed on both days for some weekdays only
#   1 a year condition before "and if"
